result.topic_en: Pencil calculations reducing a quartic equation (arising from a symmetric curve equation) to normal form and computing its invariants (9A, 27B) in terms of the parameters a, b, α, β, followed by notes on coefficients of a product of four linear forms.
result.transcription:
$(x^2y^2z^2 + 2xyz + 2\gamma xy + 2\beta yz)^2 + 4\alpha xyz\,(ax+by+cz) = 0$
$(x^2+2ax+b)^2 + 4x(\alpha x+\beta) = 0$ $\quad x = \frac{\beta}{-\zeta^2-\alpha}$
$x^4 + 4ax + x^2(2b+4a^2+4\alpha) + 4x(ab+\beta) + b^2 = 0$
$a = 1$
$b = a$
$3c = b+2a^2+2\alpha$
$d = ab+\beta$
$e = b^2$
$9A = 9c^2 - 12bd + 3ae = (b+2a^2+2\alpha)^2 - 12a^2b - 12\beta a + 3b^2 = 4b^2 - 8a^2b + 4a^4 + 4\alpha(b+2a^2) + 4\alpha^2 - 12\beta a$
$= 4(b-a^2-\alpha)^2 + [-\ldots-]\ 12(b\alpha - \beta a)$
$27B = 27c^3 - 54cbd - 27cae + 27eb^2 + 27ad^2 = (b+2a^2+2\alpha)\big((b+2a^2+2\alpha)^2 - 18a(ab+\beta) - 9b^2\big) + 27b^2 + 27(ab+\beta)^2$
$= 9(ab+\beta)([-\ldots-]\ -(4a^2-4\alpha)a) + 27\beta^2 + (b+2a^2+2\alpha)(4b+2a^2+2\alpha)(-2b+2a^2+2\alpha)$
$= 4\big[(b-a^2-\alpha)(-9(ab+\beta)a + (b+2a^2+2\alpha)(2b+a^2+\alpha)(b-a^2-\alpha))\big] + 27\beta^2$
[-$(b-a^2+\alpha)(\ldots - (b+2a^2+2\alpha)(2b+a^2+\alpha)) + 2\alpha(b+2a^2+2\alpha)(2b+a^2+\alpha) - 9\beta \ldots (b-a^2+2)(\beta a - b\alpha)$-]
$= 2(b-a^2+\alpha)^3 + 2\alpha\big(9(b+a^2+\alpha)^2 - (b-a^2-\alpha)^2\big)$
$27B = -8(b-a^2-\alpha)^3 + 36(\beta a - \alpha b)(b-a^2-\alpha) + 27\beta^2$
$(b+2a^2+2\alpha)(2b+a^2+\alpha) = 9(a^2+\alpha)b + 2b - a^2$
$\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = 2(x+a)(x^2+2ax+b) + 4(2\alpha x+\beta)$
[-$9(b+a^2+\alpha)^2(b-a^2-\alpha) + (b-a^2-\alpha)^3$-]
$3(b^2-ac) = a^2-b-2\alpha$
$2b^3 - 3abc + a^2d = \beta - 2\alpha a$
$(b-a^2-\alpha)\big(-9(ab+\beta)a - (b+2a^2+2\alpha)(2b+a^2+\alpha)\big)$
$2b^2 + 2a^4 + \ldots + 5b(a^2+\alpha)\big(-2(b-a^2-\alpha)^2 + 9(\beta a - \alpha b)$
$= 4\big(-2(b-a^2-\alpha)^3 + 9(\beta a-\alpha b)(b-a^2-\alpha)\big) + 27\beta^2$
[-$b-a^2+\alpha-2\alpha)^2$-]
[-$-2(b-a^2+\alpha)^3 + 12\alpha(b-a^2+\alpha)^2 = 24\alpha^2(b-a^2+\alpha) + 16\alpha^3$-]
$(\beta^2 + 2a\beta(\zeta^2-\alpha) + b(\zeta^2-\alpha)^2)^2 + 4(\zeta^2-\alpha)^2\beta^2\zeta^2$ $\quad a = b$
$b = -\frac12\beta$
$\beta^2 + 2a\beta(-\zeta^2-\alpha) + b(\zeta^2-\alpha)^2 \pm 2\zeta\beta(\zeta^2+\alpha) = 0$ $\quad 3c = b\alpha - a\beta$
$d = -\frac12\alpha\beta$
$e = \beta^2 - 2\alpha\beta a + b\alpha^2$
$(b-a^2-\alpha)3\beta^2 + 4(\alpha b - a\beta)^2$
$27B = (b\alpha - a\beta)^3 - 9(b\alpha+a\beta)\big(\frac12\alpha\beta^2 + b(\beta^2 - 2\alpha\beta a + b\alpha^2)\big) + 27\cdot\frac14 b\alpha^2\beta^2 + \frac{27}{4}\beta^2(\beta^2 - 2\alpha\beta a + b\alpha^2)$
$= -8(b\alpha-a\beta)^3 - 9(b\alpha - a\beta)\beta^2(\alpha + b - a^2) + \beta^2\frac{27}{4}(\beta^2 [-- 2\alpha\beta a + 2b\alpha^2-])$
$-\frac32\beta^2\alpha(b\alpha - a\beta)$
$(x+\beta_1 y + \gamma_1 z)(x+\beta_2 y+\gamma_2 z)(x+\beta_3 y + \gamma_3 z)(x+\beta_4 y + \gamma_4 z)$
$a_{4,0,0} = 1 \quad 4a_{0,3,1} = (\beta_1\beta_2\beta_3\gamma_4) \quad 6a_{0,2,2} = (\beta_1\beta_2\gamma_3\gamma_4) \quad 4a_{0,1,3} = (\beta_1\gamma_2\gamma_3\gamma_4)$
$12a_{2,1,1} = (\beta_1\gamma_2) \quad 12a_{1,2,1} = (\beta_1\beta_2\gamma_3) \quad 12a_{1,1,2} = (\beta_1\gamma_2\gamma_3)$
$(123)^2(124)^2(345)^2 \quad 4a_{3,0,1} = (\gamma_1)$
$\gamma = c_0 + c_1\beta + c_2\beta^2 + c_3\beta^3$
